entry.summaryHtml: Cocoa, roasted coffee, toasted nuts, cedar, sweet earth and mild pepper give the Special G Maduro a rounder, sweeter profile than a dry spice-led Nicaraguan. The short figurado shape should concentrate the first half before opening into a creamier cocoa-and-nut middle, with cedar and coffee lingering on the finish.
